H1.evidence: Final SFT membership is unchanged, but §7 composition equivalence also requires normalized per-row field equality; the rebuilt normalized and processed rows retain the changed CVSS fields.

H2.evidence: Every dataset-relevant UPDATE changed the predicted local or downstream artifact.

H3.evidence: Description survivorship changes are confined to the recorded old and new description-hash groups.

H4.evidence: Ordered top-15 labels stayed stable. Fixture rank-15/rank-16 margins were 7 in A and 7 in B.

H6.evidence: KEV target retained membership and only its serialized is_kev field changed.

H7.evidence: MISSING was classified MISSING_REVIEW and incremental application stopped without applying deletion.
